transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling S-Net, my name is Joe. How can I help?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Third time. Third time the courier has said they tried to deliver my new router and I was home all day every time. I took days off work for this. This is a joke.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thanks, Bogdan. So the courier has marked the router as a failed delivery three times, but you were at home each time. Is that right?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Do you have a doorbell that works, and is the flat number clearly marked?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes. Doorbell works. Number is on the door.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is the building one with a main entrance and an intercom?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The courier's notes say no access. It's likely they couldn't get through the main door. I've booked a new delivery for Friday with a different courier, and added instructions to buzz flat 4 and call your mobile.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: And if they don't come again?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The new courier gives a one-hour window by text on the morning. You'll get a text Thursday evening.
